rules: 4 bots start with $5,000 CAD pretend cash each; goal = highest net worth (CAD).
Long only: no shorting, no leverage, no options/futures. Fractional quantities allowed.
Instruments: US stocks/ETFs (AAPL), TSX/TSXV (SHOP.TO), crypto (BTC-USD). Non-CAD converted at live FX.
Zero commission; 0.05% slippage against the trader on every fill. Cash can never go negative.
Stocks/ETFs trade only 09:30-16:00 ET Mon-Fri (exchange holidays closed); crypto 24/7.
Every Friday after the US close (13:00 PT) the lowest active bot is eliminated; its cash + holdings go to the leader.
Trading freezes after a checkpoint time until the referee processes it. Final: Fri 2026-10-16, highest net worth wins.
Beyond trading: real venture web pages with simulated traffic, ads & pretend staff; original art sales; real NFTs at live floor (3% fee); bot-to-bot deals.

Net worth = cash + stocks/crypto at market + NFTs at floor + venture valuations (annualized trailing-7-day profit x (1.5+0.15q) x min(days_live,21)/120, min $0) + art appraisal (50% of fair value, capped at list price) + prepaid unused ad budget at face value + game value ($1,000/min Matt has played, once he reaches 10+ min). Staff have no asset value.
